purpose: Content-level reconciliation of the 25 Project analyses and 5 additional Markdown sources against the completed archive.

project_documents.method: Ordered paragraph and table extraction followed by sequential review to the end of each document; keyword-only extraction was not used.

markdown_sources.status: cross-project synthesis with conflicting completion claims
glyph generation, Error 07, and skill-gap audit

confirmed_against_completion_archive: The seven final bundles expose the recorded runtime ranges, terminators, row counts, mismatch counts, and unchanged-file checks listed in full-archive-audit.json.
The integrated Disk A IPS contains a 7521-byte delta intersection with the logo source range 0xB2F0–0xD35F; this supports the logo analysis at file-delta level, not emulator-screen level.
The integrated Disk A IPS contains 23330 changed bytes in total; the final KANJI1 IPS contains 12621 changed bytes across 476 32-byte slots.
The final artifacts retain a fixed-size mixed-sector D88 and fixed-size KANJI1 result; the public repository distributes only deltas and verification code.
historical_or_partial_only: Projects 1–18 document discovery, runtime probes, and failed or incomplete Korean-output attempts at their respective EOFs; their no-patch conclusions are historical checkpoints, not statements about the later integrated release.
Project 19 proves a small first-event display sample and a KANJI sample replacement, not the full event.
Projects 20–21 record changing token hypotheses; the automatic control-token repositioned images were rejected after comparison.
Project 22 manual_v2 reached a useful screen-transition checkpoint, but full glyph and D88/ROM integration was not proven there.
Project 23 records a partial 525-character repatch and glyph-generation checks; it does not establish a single complete 1441-row semantic table.
Projects 24–25 still contain unresolved mappings, intermediate tables, and incomplete runtime verification at EOF.

The five Markdown sources contain later integration claims, but their sections also preserve discarded experiments and contradictory 100-percent completion language; those claims are retained as lineage, not promoted automatically.
discarded_or_do_not_reuse: Do not merge the 513-, 525-, and 540-slot Block 1 lineages by automatic renumbering.
Do not revive E8 0B, guessed control-token positions, or automatically generated token tables after the later dump comparisons rejected them.
Do not treat generic 2D disk capacity as the capacity of this mixed-sector D88 image.
Do not treat speculative F0–F7 FDC paths, 0x0C86 row-limit interpretations, or automatic JIS/Unicode glyph naming as final evidence.
Do not infer Korean text meaning or emulator behavior from IPS offsets, glyph counts, or static CSV/JSON counts alone.
not_proven_by_repository_artifacts: A QUASI88 boot and screen-by-screen verification of every event, mouth animation, transition, ending, and game-over path.
Semantic correctness of every Korean string and every glyph display in context.
Availability or redistribution rights for the original D88, ROM, completed images, full translation tables, or glyph source assets.
A strict local build from the included archive alone; the canonical original D88 and KANJI1 ROM are intentionally user-supplied inputs.
